summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py (last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a nested add_to_cbd helper that applies rule 1 (subject triples, recursing into undescribed blank-node objects) and rule 2 (all statements whose rdf:subject is the node, no type or predicate/object matching). Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering the count cases (8, 3, 2, 0), reified cases A (8) and B (13, untyped included), incoming reification, a non-expanded blank-node reifier object, a blank-node cycle, and source immutability. Tests were not run and no commits were made. The fixture counts are my own construction sized to the spec's numbers, not the reference fixtures.
